The '''''Devastation''''' was a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] and the sister ship of the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].<ref name="FFASWTCWJA">{{SWArchive|url=games/videogames/news20081113.html|text=Fun Facts about ''Star Wars The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance''}}</ref><ref name="TCWCG" />

==Description==
The vessel was quite different from the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]; it was much larger, possessing an enormous cannon situated at the bow, with three protruding "claw"-like structures surrounding it.<ref name="SW:TCW:JA" />

==History==
The sister ship of the dreaded ''Malevolence'' and the second of their class to be built,<ref name="SW:TCW:TOEG:S1">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> the vessel was involved in a conflict that concerned [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It housed two gigantic [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]] and a single forward facing ion beam cannon powered by force crystals which were strong enough to destroy small worlds. The vessel, before being fully operational, hunted down the Republic vessel ''[[Sedawan]]'' and stormed the ship, plundering its cargo of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] crystals and capturing Jedi Master Luminara Unduli.<ref name="SW:TCW:JA" />

Its original first target was [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], but the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Sai Sircu]] betrayed the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] and charted a new course for [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, the monstrous ship was [[Battle on the Devastation|destroyed]] by the combined efforts of a Jedi strike team including [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]].<ref name="SW:TCW:JA" />
